title: Mixed Event — You deserve it! Break Time!

meta.Outline: As the livestreaming gains momentum, Haruka endeavors to create new content to keep viewers engaged. Balancing daily practice, training, school studies, and idol activities, Haruka devotes herself without a moment's rest, causing Shizuku to worry.

rows.Line: Alright, shall we move to our next segment?

Yeah, it kind of is!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We'll be looking forward to that, Minori.

rows.Line: I-I'll try my best...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What's up, Haruka?

It's just...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Something new...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'll try thinking up some ideas!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's not my strong suit, but I'll do what I can as well...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes, thank you.
I'll do the same.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We have to keep trying so that our viewers keep on smiling.
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's already this late...

rows.Line: Practice after the stream went on longer than I expected. We should all head home and try to relax.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I agree. We can all get some well-deserved rest and see each other again tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then I'll see you tomorrow...
Um... H-Haruka...!

rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka Fan
rows.Line:
E-Excuse me!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes, of course.
Hm...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Have we met before? I believe at a meet and greet...

rows.Speaker: Haruka Fan
rows.Line: What?! Y-You remember me...?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, I do. You're the one that always gave me those nice letters, right? Of course I remember.

rows.Speaker: Haruka Fan
rows.Line: I don't know what to say... Thank you so much! I can't believe that you actually remembered who I was...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And I've always appreciated your support. I'll be counting on you in the future too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, I'm sure you already know, but I'm in a group called MORE MORE JUMP! now. We'll be counting on your support as a group too, so I hope you'll stay tuned in.

rows.Speaker: Haruka Fan
rows.Line: Yes, I do. I've been watching your videos!

rows.Speaker: Haruka Fan
rows.Line: I love how we get to see a part of you that we didn't get to see on TV, Haruka...! I'm really looking forward to seeing more!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Haruka's so amazing...!
She's having an actual conversation with someone that just randomly came up to her...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, she really is something else. It has to be pretty hard to remember everyone's names too considering how many ASRUN fans there are.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: A professional through and through.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thanks for waiting...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You're really the best of the best, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wait, huh? What's gotten into you, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She couldn't believe how you handled that fan just now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
You made them so happy too.
You really are quite amazing, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Haha. Thanks.
But I feel a little embarrassed now that I know you were all watching...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No, don't say that!!
I want to learn how to do what you just did back there!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That just means you have to keep trying more and more, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-Yeah... I will...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Just don't push yourself too hard, okay?

rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (More people have begun commenting during our livestreams and it is pretty apparent that they'd like to see us try new things.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But what should we do and how...?)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: This won't be easy. Nobody on ASRUN was responsible for coming up with ideas like this...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Haruka Fan
rows.Line: I love how we get to see a part of you that we didn't get to see on TV, Haruka...! I'm really looking forward to seeing more!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (It's hardly easy and it's a lot of work... But it really is fun...!)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Alright, let's come up with some new ideas. I still have a little bit of time...
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And it looks like we're out of time, so that'll be it for today...

rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you very much.
We're thinking about doing a viewer request segment next time, so make sure to leave a comment if you have any ideas.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We'll be looking forward to your requests!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<I'm definitely commenting!>
<I hope they use my idea.>
<I wanna make Minori do stuff...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: M-Me...?! I'll do my best...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. We'll see you again next time. Farewell!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Today's stream got a lot more attention than usual. I'm glad everybody seemed to like our idea...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That was great, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Your new “Tell Us About Yourselves” idea went really well today, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And you thought of it just last night, no?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I did, but it took a while to polish up...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You really came up with that in one night?! That's incredible, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We've been pressed for ideas lately too.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You coming up with something that we can make a whole video off of really saved us, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I agree.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
It was nothing, really.
I used Minori's ideas as reference since she's been coming up with so many good ones.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So thank you, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: H-Haruka...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I'm sure it was quite a lot of work to get this idea together, wasn't it...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Our practice went longer than usual yesterday and we all seemed to get home pretty late...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
No, it really wasn't.
Coming up with it was the hardest part.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
If you say so...
Just don't overdo it, please.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you. I'll be careful.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Anyways, we're done with our stream...
How about we go somewhere to celebrate?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: This girl in my class told me about a really good crepe place too! Can we go there?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, that sounds lovely♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sorry, I don't think I can today...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What? You can't go, Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, I have a lot of homework to do today so...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Also, I think I have another good idea in mind. I'd like to work on it as soon as I can.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You already came up with another idea?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I think today's stream gave me a good idea of what our viewers want to see from us.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
So... I'm sorry, Minori.
Can I get a rain check?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah, of course!
I'll try to come up with something too!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Right. We're gonna go see Miku tomorrow too, so it might be good to take some ideas with us there.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, sounds good.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh... I need to get home soon.
I'll see you all tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Get home safe, alright...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Bye, Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka's so busy. Doing all her homework, coming up with an idea like that in just one night...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But that's just Haruka for you. She was like that even when she was with her old group.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I see...
She really is just an amazing person.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But are you sure she'll be okay? I'm really worried...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I am too...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I hope she's not pushing herself too hard...

Hi, Miku!
We'd like to talk with you about some stuff...

rows.Line:

We should watch and learn as much as we can from them!

rows.Line:
Everyone!
Thanks for coming!

rows.Line: I was able to put on a great solo show today thanks to you!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'll be doing a show with Miku and everyone else next time, so I hope to see you then too!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: MEIKO, you're the best!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: M-MEIKO...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Does that mean this SEKAI has another VIRTUAL SINGER...?

rows.Line: Oh, hello! You're all here!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I bet you're pretty surprised, right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, of course we are!
Who would've expected this...?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hi there!
You must be MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Line: Miku and the others have told me all about you girls. I'm MEIKO. It's nice to finally meet you♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I-It's nice to meet you too!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
It's a pleasure to meet you, Ms. MEIKO.
I'm sure we'll learn quite a lot from you.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, Shizuku!
Just MEIKO is totally fine!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Just MEIKO...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. It's just easier this way.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Please, I'd prefer it if you just call me by my name.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
You're sure?!
I mean, that'd be easier for us too...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. Yes, I'm sure!
I prefer everything to be casual.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I hope we can get to know each other as well as you did with Miku and everybody else.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thanks, MEIKO...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, it's my pleasure!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: By the way, what brings you here today?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: About that... We felt that our videos were getting a little stale, so we came here to talk about some new ideas with you today...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: New ideas? That sounds like fun!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, we'd be glad to♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thank you. Mind if we get started then?
Our first one is...
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
A taste test?
What exactly would you be doing?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We'd all make something, like cookies or cake, and try to guess which ones were made by who!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
What?!
Can you really tell who made something just by tasting it?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I've never actually tried...
But I think we'll sort of be able to get a good idea, you know?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, it might not be as hard as it seems...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Really? I'm not sure I could...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You sure about that? I think it'd be pretty easy.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Just based on everyone's personalities... For example, Haruka would follow a recipe to a tee.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori would mix up salt with sugar or something, and you'd turn flan into some other kind of egg dish, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: N-No, I wouldn't do that!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And flan turning into a different kind of egg dish wouldn't be so bad either!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But that's not really a good thing, right...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I think it'll be fun because of how different your personalities are!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, if you're all okay with cooking...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: How about this...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Hehe. Looks like they're all having fun.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (We've been having some trouble coming up with new ideas, but I'm glad we came to talk with Miku and the others today. We're finally getting some work done.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (We should be able to have a few fully ready by the end of the day...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Good...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Haruka, are you okay?
Are you feeling tired...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry...
I stayed up a little too late last night is all...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I see...
You have been very busy lately...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Haha. Things sort of just piled up so...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Um, Haruka...
I may be in no position to say this but...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I think you should take a little break.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: If you don't find some time to relax, I'm afraid that your body won't be able to keep up.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I may not be as good at it as you are, Haruka, but I'll keep trying to come up with new ideas as well...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I appreciate the concern.
I'm sorry for making you worry like that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I don't have much homework to do now and we've come up with some good ideas today, so I think I'll be able to sleep well tonight.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'll get that rest you were talking about, okay?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Are you sure...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: If you say so...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Haruka! Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I overheard some of what you were just saying. You're a really hard worker, aren't you, Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
A hard worker...?
I don't think I'm doing that much...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Everyone else does what I'm doing, like practicing and coming up with new ideas for our streams...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But Miku told me that you're always looking after everyone during practices and even get really good grades in school.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You're studious and help everyone out during practice. Your work ethic's so admirable...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
It is?
Miku and the others told you all this?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm sure it was Minori who told them all about you, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see. That's a bit embarrassing...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
No, don't be!
I think it's wonderful!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But are you leaving enough time for yourself? You do seem to be spending a lot of time working with everybody else...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes, I think so.
I also train and practice at home.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I kept forgetting to ask you about that. How much time do you spend each day?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
How much...? Let me think...
Two or three hours each night?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Each night? That means mornings too...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes, mornings too.
I wake up at six to train each morning.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I've been doing that since I was still in ASRUN. It's sort of a daily routine for me, so I'm completely used to it now...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Wow, that's incredible...
You really are a hard worker!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's nothing, really...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But resting is just as important as practicing, okay?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's great that you're investing this much time into being an idol, but it's important to give yourself some time to relax too.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Give your mind and body a chance to get refreshed, you know♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Okay...
I'll make sure to do that for our group's sake.

rows.Speaker: Members
rows.Line: Shizuku, congratulations on becoming the lead!

rows.Speaker: Members
rows.Line:
I can't believe it...
It hasn't even been six months since she joined Cheerful * Days and she's already the lead.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Everybody, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I was very surprised to hear that I'd been chosen for this role too...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I know that I'll have to keep doing my best to make sure our fans are happy with this.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: There may be some growing pains at first, but I'm hoping that we can work together to get through them.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Let's keep making Cheerful * Days as exciting as it can be...!

rows.Speaker: Program director
rows.Line: Shizuku, we've been looking forward to seeing you again! Our ratings have been booming thanks to you!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm just happy that everyone is enjoying this so much. Thank you for always having me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Today's talking points are about what I want to do as the lead of Cheerful * Days and the toughest parts of being an idol...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (The script even has what I'm supposed to say...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: “I'm Shizuku Hinomori of Cheerful * Days. It's an honor to be chosen as the group's lead.”

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: “I have you, the fans, to thank for allowing me to become the lead. I promise to do everything I can to make this group more fun and exciting.”

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: “We'll be counting on your support.”

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (This isn't me...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But I have to tell the fans and everyone else this, don't I...?)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I have to be the person they want me to be...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (As long as I'm the lead for this group...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Can I really handle this...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hinomori...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm sorry.
Did I startle you?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh...! K-Kiritani...?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, I'm Hinomori.
It's so nice to meet you...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I'm Haruka Kiritani.
It's nice to meet you too.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It really is...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I never thought that we'd be on the same show together. I've been wanting to talk to you for some time now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: With me...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, since you became your group's lead just after debuting.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But the reason why I was given this role isn't because of any particular talents I have...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'm really nothing special.
I'm just...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, you are.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I saw Cheerful * Days perform a little while ago and you were the one that I thought shined the brightest then, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It felt pretty clear that you're the one that works the hardest out of everyone.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Which is why I think you were the obvious choice to become the lead.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Kiritani...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
H-Hinomori? What's wrong?
Are you okay?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'm sorry, it's just...
I'm a little scared is all...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm wondering if it's really okay for me to be the lead...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
No, I understand...
Cheerful * Days is a fairly large group, so being the lead does come with just that much responsibility.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I'm just so concerned...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Doesn't it ever bother you, Kiritani...?
All these expectations and all this pressure?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Me? Well...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I try to stay focused on what I need to do as the leader of my group, and how to meet our fans' expectations. I'm not sure that I feel that pressure though...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I see...
You're such a strong girl, Kiritani.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, I'm really not. I just genuinely love being an idol is all...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You love being an idol?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I do. I've been enamored by them since I was little.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I wanted to be just like them. I want to stand up on the stage and give hope to as many people as I can...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: My goal is to keep doing that and I really enjoy all of it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Kiritani...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
You really are amazing.
The best of the best. It's like you're shining even brighter in person than when I see you on TV...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I want to meet my fans' expectations too, but I'm not sure I can get myself to do what you do, Kiritani...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm sure you can, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You thinking this hard about what you can do for your groupmates and fans means that you're trying your best.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Being the lead means there will be added pressure and responsibilities compared to everybody else...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I'm sure you'll be just fine, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Kiritani...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
And please call me Haruka.
We're both idols after all.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Then... Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Please call me Shizuku...
And let's keep doing everything we can!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Haruka seemed like the perfect idol even back then...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Even now... She works so hard with us behind the scenes when the cameras aren't rolling, and treats her fans so well too...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (She's the ideal idol that everyone wants...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (It must be incredibly difficult to maintain that persona...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Does she really always stay in character like that...?
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 2-D

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Shizuku, what's wrong?
You look pretty down.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, Airi...
Um... It's nothing, really...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Your face tells a different story.
Anyways...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Wanna have lunch together?
And you can tell me if there's something actually bothering you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you, Airi...
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So what's up?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Well, there's nothing wrong per se, but something has been concerning me a little...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Like what?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Um, it's about Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're worried about Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I am. We all know that she works harder than any of us, even when she's all by herself, right?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm concerned about how much she's making herself do...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I get where you're coming from, Shizuku, but I'm sure she'll be fine.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I was worried about her too for a little while.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You know how she stays in character even in her free time? She does that to maintain the image her fans have of her.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I even asked her if she ever takes a break from that, but she said that she knows how to switch off so I'm fairly certain she does rest when she needs to...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I never knew...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But at the same time, she really doesn't like showing any weakness, so it does seem natural to feel worried...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You know what...?
What if we asked her to come out and do something with us?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Such as...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We've only been seeing each other for lessons, practice and meetings to talk about our stream, right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So why not just go out and have some fun together?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, I see. If we invite her out during our day off, she may be able to actually relax and recover.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Exactly!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
That sounds great! Thank you, Airi.
I'll try inviting Haruka then...
After school

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Phew...
Okay, let's stop here for today.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I'm so tired...!
I can't move my legs anymore...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. You did really well today too, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But there were still a few steps you weren't getting quite right, so we'll focus on that during our next lesson.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Eep...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Haha...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So when should we have our next practice? Tomorrow, this weekend, whenever you're all free...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: H-Haruka! About that...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh? Yes?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What if we took a break and all went out somewhere together?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We've been so busy with practice and making videos, right? I thought that it would be nice to take a break every once in a while.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: A break...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm all for that!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We haven't done anything together in so long! Going somewhere with just us would be so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So how about it? All work and no play's gonna make us dull idols, right...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! We can go do karaoke, go to a cafe, get some sweets together, go shopping and...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
That's a lot of things...
Well, it's our day off, so as long as we don't overdo it, it'll be okay.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What do you think, Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, okay...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
That sounds nice.
It is important to rest on our days off so...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Really? Great...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (If we go out and have fun together, I'm sure Haruka will be able to find time to relax.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (She deserves to get a break from everything.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Let's have as much fun as we can!
Holiday
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm ten minutes early. I wonder if Minori and the others are here already...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, it's Haruka!
Over here!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Wait, Shizuku, keep it down...!
We'll probably be fine since we're covering our faces and in a big crowd, but just in case...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Good morning, Haruka!
We're gonna have so much fun today!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'd like that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You all came pretty early.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I stopped by ahead of time to renew my commuter pass. Minori just couldn't wait as you can see.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But I'm a little surprised that you came so early, Shizuku. You usually get lost somewhere before actually finding anyone.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I left my house early today with that in mind so that I wouldn't be late.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And you still got lost along the way...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Anyways, what should we do today?
Karaoke? Shopping? Or...?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hmm... So many options...
How about we start with karaoke?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sounds good! We can even do a blast from the past idol medley!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, what should I sing...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I'm gonna sing some ASRUN songs!
I can cheer for Haruka at the same time!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That might be challenging, Minori...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But it still sounds fun. Let's go.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, let's!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (It's Haruka's day to relax and we have quite a bit in store for her. I'm sure everything will go great today...!)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, it's off to karaoke then!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: No, wait...! Shizuku, come back here...!
Main Street

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: *Sigh*... That was really fun!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That was the first time in a while for me too. It was nice to go and do that for a change.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I agree. We all got chances to sing too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: *Sigh*...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Is something wrong, Minori?
You've been sighing quite a bit...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm guessing she reverted back to being a fan for a bit there and got an idol overload.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I was a little surprised when she went from cheering to bowing and chanting partway through...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sigh*...
So this is bliss...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad this made you so happy.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Now, where to next?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Let's see...
How about we take a little break at a cafe?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: There's actually a cafe that I'd like to go to. The cake they make is supposed to be very good.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sure, let's go.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Delicious cake! I can't wait♪
What kind should I get?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
But don't get too carried away.
Sugar is an idol's archenemy.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's the thing!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hm? What is?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: This cafe opened just recently, but they make desserts by using as little sugar as possible.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They do? Then maybe I can have a little more than usual...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Do you think they'll agree to an interview?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What? An interview?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What's this all of a sudden?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: There have to be a lot of girls out there that want to enjoy sweets that are made this way, and I was thinking that we could make a video that introduces stores that make them.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, yeah...! I never thought about that! Haruka, that's a great idea!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We definitely could do that, but today's our day off so let's just try to have fun, okay?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, you're right. Trying to introduce a store we've never been to would probably be disrespectful to that place and our fans...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: For now, we can go there, try some things that the store recommends and learn about who might benefit the most.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What happened to just having fun...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Even though it's our day off, she still can't let go...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Just for today, I want her to forget about practicing and working on our stream.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Once we get there, we'll just have to make it so Haruka can focus on enjoying eating as many sweets as she likes.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'll lead us there. Let's go!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm so sorry...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No, Shizuku, it's okay! You don't have to apologize!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But it was a pretty big leap of faith to expect you to be able to guide us around anywhere.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Shizuku, please don't feel bad.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That reminds me, there's a new cafe that just opened up in the mall by the station.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We can go to the place you were talking about another time, Shizuku. How about we go here for now?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, that's probably for the best. Is that okay with you, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes... Again, I'm so sorry...
Shopping Mall

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I think I'll have an Earl Grey.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The scone set looks good so I think I'll get that! What about you, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I'll get an Earl Grey and...
Oh, this strawberry ice cream too♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: *Sigh*...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Even though I managed to find a store that Haruka might be able to really enjoy, it ended up being a waste...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (No... Now's not the time for talk like that. We still have time, so we just have to make sure Haruka gets to relax as much as possible...!)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
What are you getting, Shizuku?
I'll call someone over if you're ready.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Okay, I'll try to decide now.
Let's see, the drinks page is...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (The Relaxation Tea Set Special...?)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Oh, this just might do it. I could order two for Haruka and myself too. This may be the perfect way to get her to relax...!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi, I know what I'd like to get!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, uh... Okay.
Excuse me!!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, this is nice.
We can people-watch a little too while we're here.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah!
It'd also be nice to come back here after practice sometime.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But Shizuku's order still hasn't arrived yet. It's just tea, right? Why is it taking longer than the scones...?

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line:
And here it is...
The Relaxation Tea Set Special.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh? Oh my...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Th-There's six teapots?! Why...?!

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line: Oh? I'm certain that it was written on the menu...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
On the menu?
Um...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The Relaxation Tea Set Special comes with three different kinds of tea served in their own pots... It is best enjoyed when with a large group...?!

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line: Two of these makes for six tea pots in total...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: B-But that's so much...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You didn't see that part? What are we supposed to do now? There's no way we can drink all this...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: If it's alright with you, Shizuku, would you mind sharing with me...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I only ordered a cup of Earl Grey, so I think I can handle two pots or so.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
But there's still a ton even after that.
I'll help too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah, me too!
The aroma's really nice.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you, everyone...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (She's drinking the tea I ordered for her, but this isn't working out the way I'd hoped...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I have to keep trying. I have to get her to relax and enjoy herself more...!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (The event that's being held here... It's a crafting fair for scented candles? This may work too!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Would it be alright if we tried this out?
It sounds very nice.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
You're right! It's so cute too♪
I'd like to try too!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I didn't know that candles were made like this. It's so interesting even though it's my first time trying.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(Yes, thank goodness...!
She's genuinely having fun...!)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Whoa...?!
What's this smell? It's starting to get pretty bad...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
S-Shizuku...!
You shouldn't be putting so much fragrance oil in!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Really? But the instructions said to put around 100 drops in...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No, Shizuku, it said just ten!
It won't smell very nice if you put that much in!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh no!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks, Haruka. You saved us by apologizing to the event staff and all the people that were there with us...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, you don't need to thank me for just that.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I don't know what to say...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
It's okay, Shizuku, really.
Accidents happen.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah, she's right!
It happens to me sometimes too!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Just be a little more careful, okay?
You've sort of been in and out all day.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I will...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Are you getting tired, Shizuku?
Maybe we should call it a day...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, uh... No, I'm alright!
I appreciate your concern...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I've been trying so hard to make sure Haruka gets some time to relax and enjoy herself...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But I ended up making her worry about me instead...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: *Sigh*...
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Alright, where to next?
I got my hands on what I wanted, so I'm good with pretty much anywhere.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Karaoke did it for me, so I'm okay with anything at this point too!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I don't mind either as long as we can all enjoy ourselves... Any ideas, Shizuku...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I can't let it end just yet. Haruka hasn't been able to relax at all...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, uh... No, I'm not sure either... Shall we go for a little walk instead?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Sure, that sounds nice.
We might even find something to do along the way.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're trying to find new stream ideas, aren't you...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I just get the feeling that you can only come up with certain ideas when you're doing stuff like this, you know?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah, that might be true...!
I'll help look for ideas too...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
But it's our day off...
I was hoping that we'd be able to have fun instead...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, I agree. No more brainstorming!
Let's just be regular high schoolers and have fun!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Okay.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Look! That accessory shop looks really cute!
Can we go in just for a little bit...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, let's go. I kinda want to take a look too. What about you two?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I'll wait here.
It looks pretty crowded inside.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I will too...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Okay.
We'll be right back!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hm...?
Is something wrong, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, um...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's just that I feel terrible about causing you so much trouble today...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Don't worry about it. I haven't been.
Besides, life is more interesting when you add a little spice to it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I am slightly concerned about something...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You are?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It seemed like you had quite a bit on your mind today, Shizuku. If there's anything bothering you, I'd be happy to help...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I, um... It's that...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I've been thinking about you, Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wait, me?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I have. You've been working so hard with everything from lessons, practices, making videos and even greeting your fans...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I was so worried that you were pushing yourself too hard...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's why I wanted us all to go out together today. It was so that you would have some time to relax.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thank you for being so thoughtful.
But I'm fine, really.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Things do get tough sometimes, but I do take breaks when I need to. Today was actually a lot of fun too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, I already know.
You're really the perfect idol.
Back then and even now...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You put your fans first, look after your group and keep doing everything in your power for everyone.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I want you to take good care of yourself too, Haruka. I honestly think that you were still looking out for everyone else too much today...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Take care of myself...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But resting is just as important as practicing, okay?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's great that you're investing this much time into being an idol, but it's important to give yourself some time to relax too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(It's already 10:00 pm...
Practice did run a little late I guess...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I need to finish up my homework, think of some ideas for our videos and...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Going in this direction should work for now, but we also may want to start thinking about more long-term solutions soon...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (More people have begun commenting during our livestreams and it is pretty apparent that they'd like to see us try new things.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But what should we do and how...?)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Alright, let's come up with some new ideas. I still have a little bit of time...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You're right...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I may be doing too much without actually realizing it...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I stretch and take breaks to relieve myself of stress each day...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But that probably doesn't actually count as relaxing, does it? I think I convinced myself somewhere along the way that fitness works as a substitute for rest.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So that means...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I do want to relax...
But I'm not sure how...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: My life's revolved around being an idol for so long that it almost feels foreign to me...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What should we do...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Um... What if you stopped some of the things that you usually do and just try to have fun instead...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The things I usually do...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I feel like I am having fun and finding fulfillment in running each morning or staying up late thinking of ideas for our stream.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It is a little hard sometimes, but I'm not sure if I was pushing myself too hard...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Haruka was never putting on a face when it came to being “the perfect idol”...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (This is what she truly loves doing. That's why she's never felt any stress all this time, no matter what happened...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
You really are amazing...
That's why you're the best of the best, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Me being such a worrywart and wanting her to relax more may not be quite what she wants...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But I am certain that working this hard has its consequences, even if it's her we're talking about...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (In that case...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm sorry, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You really are doing what you truly love and want to do, yes?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I apologize for assuming that you were doing too much or pushing yourself too hard.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But you've also been looking after the rest of us and not just yourself. I'm sure that hasn't been easy either.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's why I'd like you to talk to us and rely on us more when things do get tough for you...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We may not be able to do that just yet, but we as a group want to be able to support you too, Haruka. As MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You don't have to keep thinking about us night and day.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Maybe I don't have to...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, you're right. I'll try to learn to relax more, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
No trying! No learning!
Just rest and relax!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, right... I see...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I'm still not exactly sure what I'm supposed to do. I've never really had the chance to do this...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What I considered as my breaks were filled with brainstorming, training or trying something out...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I see...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What do you think I should do when I have time like this...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Well, as long as it's something you really want to do, Haruka, I'll gladly join you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Anything you like.
Something or somewhere that just lets you relax and enjoy yourself. I believe that's the answer.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Somewhere I can relax and enjoy myself...?
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka! Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Minori, Airi! You're back...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sorry for the wait. There were so many people in line during checkout.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
No, it's okay.
Did you get anything?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
We did! Look!
Ta-daa!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, penguin keychains...?
They're so cute!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I know! That's why we got a whole set of them!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, four in different colors!
It was hard to say no to these...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, that's so nice.
Thank you for getting these.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And this one's yours, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thanks... It's absolutely adorable...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad you like it.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Haruka's such a softie when it comes to penguins too...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Exactly! She's always so helpful and reliable, which is why the face she makes when she's looking at them is so cute!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Does this count as enjoying myself...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I believe so.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: These sort of answers always seem to be right under our noses.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Right under our noses...?
Like a happy little blue penguin?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehehe.
You would think a blue penguin would be easy to find too.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
A blue penguin?
What are you talking about?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Nothing. Just an inside joke.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But now that you mention it...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Would it be alright if we go to one last place before we call it a day?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's a little out of the way, so we may end up staying out a bit later than we planned...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I'm completely okay with that!
I'll go where you go, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, me too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Is that okay with you, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, of course!
Penguin Cafe

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh my...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow! So many penguin-themed goods!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, you're right...!
Penguin cushions, penguin piggy banks, penguin-themed curtains... So much stuff...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
And the menu's filled with penguins too!
This penguin macaron looks so cute♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I never knew this place existed... Oh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So cute...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Is this your first time coming here too, Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Y-Yes...
A girl in my class told me about this place...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I've been meaning to go, but I haven't had the chance to because of other things I've also been wanting to do...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I need to thank you, Shizuku, for giving me this opportunity...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: H-Haruka! You have to see this menu!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: This! The Deluxe Emperor Penguin Parfait!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's really big and they put a little emperor penguin figure on top! You even get to keep it if you order it!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You're right...! It looks so good, and really cute too...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Careful, Minori...
Haruka isn't allowed to have any sugary sweets right now, remember?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Gasp*! I forgot...!
I'm so sorry, Haruka...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: If it's okay with everyone else, would you mind sharing one together...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's that... I kind of want the penguin figure that comes with it. I can at least eat the citrusy fruits that come with it too.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'd like to try it too.
Would you two like to as well...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: If you want to get it, Haruka, I'm in too!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's get it♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you. I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line:
Here you are!
The Deluxe Emperor Penguin Parfait!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Whoa! It's bigger than I thought it would be!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
But it looks so good♪
I should take a picture...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, me too...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's gonna block out the light from that angle, so why not try from Shizuku's side?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right.
I'll try from over there then...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hm? This penguin has a baby with it...?!

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line:
Congratulations!
Only one in ten of these figures is paired as parent and child like this! Today's your lucky day!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Really?!
That's great, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
They're a family...?!
I can have this?! Are you really sure?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (We had our share of mishaps today...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But I'm glad I was able to see Haruka smile like this in the end.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku, I'll start divvying up the parfait. Mind handing me some of those plates?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Sure. Let's see... Plates... Plates...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, I need to be careful not to break any...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I'm sure you'll be fine, Shizuku!
I'll catch them if you do drop any!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Why is it that I don't find that reassuring at all...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: B-But...!

rows.Speaker: Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay... Let's eat!

rows.Speaker: Minori & Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line: Yeah!
